text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking around
town...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now that I'm done at the crepe
shop,
I've got my shift at the
convenience store coming
up in... about
ten minutes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I really want to use this time to
train,
but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you! Perfect timing! Do you think
I can
pick your brain for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Do you know any training exercises I can
do in
ten minutes?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: フォームの確認はどう？
choice_data_list_en: When in doubt, hit the track!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're right! I might as well just
start
running rather than waste time
trying to think of
something!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I never would have thought to
check my
running form!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, I haven't gone
back to
the basics for a while... Yeah,
that's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the advice! I'm gonna get
right into it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But before that, I've got some insider
info in
exchange for your kindness!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You should definitely drop by that crepe
shop on
Mondays! I'll give you a
discount as thanks for
today! ♪
